fee_notes: Minimum $35,000; higher amounts possible based on protected area size, number of locations, market potential, population base, character of residential properties, and total market turnover. Additional $5,000 fee if granted right to open additional physical location within Protected Area. In 2025, Initial Franchise Fees paid ranged from $0 to $35,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") at a minimum amount of $35,000 at the time of signing the Franchise Agreement. In 2025, the Initial Franchise Fees paid ranged from $0 to $35,000.
